name: Whitelabel
description: The white-label test site at whitelabel.astrid.cc, styled after GitHub: light canvas by default, GitHub's blue as the accent, the system font stack, a flat neutral voice. Deliberately keeps astrid.cc as its domain — it is served from the *.astrid.cc wildcard, and Google sign-in on a preview only works by bouncing through astrid.cc with the .astrid.cc session cookie (lib/auth-host.ts), which a different brand domain would break. Every capability stays on, like production. Deploy with `npx tsx scripts/deploy-brand-preview.ts whitelabel --alias whitelabel.astrid.cc`.
